short: The share of total sales each dish accounts for.
seoTitle: Menu Mix — Meaning, Formula and Example
metaDescription: Menu mix is the distribution of sales across items — what share of covers each dish accounts for. Menu mix is the only way to see that shift.
definition: Menu mix is the distribution of sales across items — what share of covers each dish accounts for. It is the popularity half of menu engineering and drives the blended food cost of the whole restaurant.
bodyHtml:
Why Menu Mix matters

Blended food cost can rise without any recipe or price changing, purely because customers shifted toward lower-margin dishes. Menu mix is the only way to see that shift.

Menu Mix formula

Item mix % = Units sold of item ÷ Total units sold × 100

Weighting contribution by mix gives the blended contribution per cover.

How Menu Mix works in practice

Pull item-wise sales counts from your POS monthly and compare them with contribution per item. Where the mix is drifting toward plowhorses, menu layout and staff recommendations are the fastest levers.

faq.question: Why did my food cost rise with no price change?
faq.answer: Almost always a menu mix shift toward dishes with higher food cost percentages.

faq.question: How does menu design change the mix?
faq.answer: Position, boxing and staff recommendations measurably shift what people order, which is why layout is a margin decision.
